protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-327 protocol-compliance bug, not withdrawn. Noise spec 9.3 forbids sending encrypted data after MixKeyAndHash(psk) unless the sender has already contributed a self-chosen ephemeral (e). Vendor GHSA-253q-9q78-63x4 and CVE-2026-24785 (cveawg.mitre.org state PUBLISHED, not rejected) describe PQ *_psk0 defaults that mix PSK-derived k before that randomization. Source: HandshakePattern::add_psks prepends Token::Psk to initiator message 0 with no validity check; noise_pqnk_psk0/noise_pqkk_psk0 are noise_pqnk()/noise_pqkk().add_psks(&[0], ...) yielding first-message [Psk, Skem, E]. Sink: PqHandshake::write_message_impl in src/handshakestate/pq.rs Token::Psk -> mix_key_and_hash(psk) sets k, then Token::Skem encrypt_and_hash(KEM ciphertext) before Token::E MixKey(e.public_key). Same unchecked helper later builds hybridNKpsk0/hybridKKpsk0 from [Skem, E, ...] bases. Issue https://github.com/jmlepisto/clatter/issues/18 independently exhibits noise_pqkk_psk0 as psk,skem,e.
